notes:
Storage sizes are in the Valheim Data page. Every chest, barrel, pot and gift box, the cart, the Karve, Longship and Drakkar, and the world's loot chests now list their capacity - a Barrel holds 12, the Wardrobe 50, the Cart 18. There's a Containers filter under Special to see the lot at once. A container's slot count lives nowhere in the item or piece data, so it's read straight off the game's own Container component.

The Dashboard was counting two things wrong. Bosses read out of 7 because it kept its own copy of the boss list and never learned about the eighth Forsaken - both pages now share one. Recipes Mastered compared a count of recipe tokens against a count of item rows, which double-counted items sharing a token and padded your score with the hammer and hoe build modes. Both sides now count the same thing, so the number will read lower and be right.

The Moose is tameable, and it eats Lingonberries. Taming data is now read from the game rather than a hand-kept list, so the next creature they add turns up on its own.
